findings.claim: inputNames returns an empty string when changed reports the tree but the per-path parse names no path, so the re-entry check returns prior and the proof window sees no change.
findings.evidence: unit_run.go inputNames builds a path-to-entry map in which the last entry wins. A path appears twice in diff --raw -z only under copy detection (the user's diff.renames=copies), which the snapshot's porcelain diff honours. With default Git config this does not happen.
findings.change: When changed names the tree and no path differs, name the worktree generically, or pin -c diff.renames=true on the snapshot's diff.

findings.claim: A stop written by treeMoved names the changed inputs twice in Stop.Class: once in the failed step's reason and again as the suffix added for InputsChanged.
findings.evidence: treeMoved sets the step reason to "the check's inputs changed during the step: X" and sets round.InputsChanged to X. holdFailedStep then appends "; the check's inputs changed during the checks: X". This follows brief A2 and A4 literally.
findings.change: None required. Optionally skip the suffix when the failed step's reason already names the inputs.
findings.relation: rule: a stop names its input once
